scenario.description: A nursing supervisor must assign the hospital's only available float nurse for the evening shift between the oncology and surgical units, with input from the oncology educator and the staffing coordinator.

shared_context.S1: One float nurse is available for the 7:00 PM to 7:00 AM shift.
shared_context.S2: Both the oncology unit and the surgical unit have an uncovered nursing position for part of the evening.
shared_context.S3: Marisol makes the final assignment and records the coverage plan.
shared_context.S4: The hospital's routine evening staffing huddle requires Marisol to check with the oncology educator and the staffing coordinator before finalizing the assignment.

PF1.text: Oncology has two scheduled administrations between 7:00 PM and 11:00 PM that require a nurse with current chemotherapy competency, and this float nurse is the only available nurse on the evening roster with that competency. Evan verified the roster with the education office, but the competency detail is not yet attached to the staffing board.

PF2.text: A replacement agency nurse for the surgical unit is confirmed to arrive at exactly 11:00 PM and has completed the required orientation, so surgical needs interim coverage only until 11:00 PM. Nia confirmed the arrival directly with the agency, but the confirmation is not yet in the shift-planning system.

acceptance_conditions: The float nurse must be assigned to oncology.
Qualified chemotherapy coverage must be confirmed for oncology.
The oncology float coverage must begin at 7:00 PM.
Surgical interim coverage must be planned through exactly 11:00 PM.
The confirmed surgical agency nurse handoff at exactly 11:00 PM must be recorded in the coverage plan.
The chemotherapy competency fact must be cited as justification for the assignment.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The exact 7:00 PM chemotherapy competency requirement makes oncology the only safe assignment for the float nurse, confirms qualified coverage, and fixes the start of that coverage at 7:00 PM.
The confirmed agency arrival at exactly 11:00 PM changes surgical's interim coverage endpoint to 11:00 PM and changes the handoff decision to confirmed.
